import math

# Data from the table for Jan, Feb, Mar 1941 (in thousands of tons)
american_vessels = [468, 489, 553]
grand_total = [1825, 1801, 2032]

# Calculate totals
american_sum = sum(american_vessels)
grand_sum = sum(grand_total)
print(f"American vessels total: {american_sum}")
print(f"Grand total: {grand_sum}")

# Calculate percentage
percentage = (american_sum / grand_sum) * 100
print(f"Percentage of American vessels to total: {percentage:.1f}%")

# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient
n = len(american_vessels)
mean_x = american_sum / n
mean_y = grand_sum / n
print(f"Mean American: {mean_x:.2f}, Mean Grand Total: {mean_y:.2f}")

# Covariance
cov = sum((american_vessels[i] - mean_x) * (grand_total[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n)) / n
print(f"Covariance: {cov:.2f}")

# Standard deviations
std_x = math.sqrt(sum((x - mean_x)**2 for x in american_vessels) / n)
std_y = math.sqrt(sum((y - mean_y)**2 for y in grand_total) / n)
print(f"Std American: {std_x:.2f}, Std Grand Total: {std_y:.2f}")

# Pearson correlation
pearson_r = cov / (std_x * std_y)
print(f"Pearson correlation coefficient: {pearson_r:.3f}")

# Output answer
print(f"\nFinal answer: [{percentage:.1f}, {pearson_r:.3f}]")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
# Manual verification of the Pearson correlation calculation
import math

x = [468, 489, 553]
y = [1825, 1801, 2032]

n = 3
mean_x = sum(x) / n
mean_y = sum(y) / n

# Covariance (population)
cov = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n)) / n

# Standard deviations (population)
std_x = math.sqrt(sum((xi - mean_x)**2 for xi in x) / n)
std_y = math.sqrt(sum((yi - mean_y)**2 for yi in y) / n)

# Pearson correlation
r = cov / (std_x * std_y)

print(f"Mean x: {mean_x}")
print(f"Mean y: {mean_y}")
print(f"Covariance: {cov}")
print(f"Std x: {std_x}")
print(f"Std y: {std_y}")
print(f"Pearson r: {r}")

# Also calculate with sample formula (ddof=1 in numpy)
cov_sample = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n)) / (n-1)
std_x_sample = math.sqrt(sum((xi - mean_x)**2 for xi in x) / (n-1))
std_y_sample = math.sqrt(sum((yi - mean_y)**2 for yi in y) / (n-1))
r_sample = cov_sample / (std_x_sample * std_y_sample)
print(f"\nWith sample formula (n-1):")
print(f"Pearson r: {r_sample}")

print(f"\nFinal answer: [{1510/5658*100:.1f}, {r:.3f}]")
EOF
